{{Top|leg}}
A '''tunnel master''' was one who oversaw illegal races in the tunnels of the [[garbage pit]] under [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They made sure the tunnels were clear of unwanted people and [[Droid/Legends|droids]] who would alert the authorities. They also examined all the contestants and announced when the race begins.
